annotations.title: Book a product on an order

description: Add a quantity of a product to an order, allocating inventory (creates a planning and a line). By default adds to an existing planning for the same product if there is one. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_fulfillments with a book_product action.

confirm_shortage.description: true to accept a shortage warning when booking on a reserved or started order.

mode.description: infer_planning (default): reuse the product's planning if any; create_new: always a new line; update_existing: add to planning_id.

name: booqable_book_product
title: Book a product on an order
